validity.replay: Both original receiver-only paths must match1000/1000 labels and every recorded label logit before new arms. Small-cohort pass is not accepted.
validity.fixed_environment: Model/data/checkpoint/config/vendor/torch/CUDA/flags and input tokens must match the validated baseline.

execution_policy.automatic_scheduler: No scheduled polling or automatic expansion is part of this fixed experiment.
execution_policy.on_failure: Save actual evidence; no unchanged retry, no threshold changes to manufacture success.
execution_policy.publication: Original code and aggregate evidence only; no question texts, private per-item files, tokens or author code.

question: Does preserving the native classifier uncertainty or eight-score distribution reduce changes caused by same-class cross-question packet substitutions?
status_at_registration: Follow-up after the class-only development intervention failed its fixed rule and exploratory margin strata were inspected; no confidence-matched model outputs observed.

arms.matched: Replay native other-agent packet, same private receiver context, author receiver-only terminal readout; exact predictions and all8 logits must match validated cross1 for both agents on all1000.
arms.margin_matched: Within each frozen predicted class, sort original top1-minus-top2 raw message-classifier logits, then swap adjacent pairs; the final3 in an odd-size class form a cycle. Deterministic ID tie-breaks, no fixed point and bijection.
arms.posterior_matched: Within each frozen predicted class, compute softmax at temperature1. Greedily take closest available pairs in Euclidean8-score distance; final2 or3 form a cycle. Deterministic ID tie-breaks. This is approximate matching, not an optimal assignment or calibrated probability.

fixed_measurements.reference: The mean changed-label rate of the two already fixed random within-class plans on the same1000 questions, separately by receiver: .055 and .077.
fixed_measurements.candidate_rule: For an arm, both receivers must reduce changed predictions by at least50% relative to that prior random-plan mean, and each absolute accuracy change versus matched must be<=.02. No pooling directions to rescue failure.

pre_execution_matching_gate: For each receiver, margin matching mean margin distance<=.05 of prior random-plan mean;8-score matching mean Euclidean score distance<=.25 and p95<=.5 of corresponding prior random-plan mean. Verified before model execution.

decision_rule.margin_pass: Candidate scalar-uncertainty matching explanation, still no demonstrated scalar codec or semantic sufficiency.
decision_rule.margin_fail_scores_pass: Candidate information beyond winning class and scalar margin in the8-score distribution; still no8-score codec demonstration.
decision_rule.both_fail: This approximate matching does not meet the operational rule. Residual geometric or content effects, or imperfect matching, remain; no automatic training/depth extension.

limitations: Development follow-up; old class-only sufficiency failure remains unchanged.
Packets remain full continuous donor packets; successful matching does not establish a low-bit codec.
The score distribution may carry alternative-answer identity as well as uncertainty; it is not purely scalar confidence.
Approximate nearest donors can differ substantially in rare uncertain cases; failure cannot exclude all confidence-based explanations.
Matched donors may share other properties; no isolated semantic mechanism or independent confirmation.
Conditional bootstrap excludes donor-plan dependence/uncertainty. No population equivalence claim.
Official validation926 remains untouched; no new training, paid procurement, local models or scheduler.
